name: Project Comprehension Bootstrap (deterministic system-map + boot-packet)
purpose: The Life Orchestrator's Project Comprehension Bootstrap (PCB) mechanism (i46, arch position 44). A stdlib-only Python 3.10-compatible worker (project_map.py) + pwsh 7.4.6 entrypoint that deterministically HARVESTS mechanical repo facts (module/widget dirs + skill.json manifest fields, core-doc list + LF-normalized sizes + DOC_PROTOCOL s2 budgets via the IMPORTED parse_budgets(), the s2 owner rows, DECISION_LOG_INDEX ids, the PROCESS_MANDATE machine header, the ARCHITECTURE_MAP arch spine, and git HEAD/dirty as inputs), VALIDATES the canonical map state (schema/grammar/enums, global id uniqueness, referential integrity, per-FIELD provenance coverage, derived-field authorship ban, harvest/claims conflict, coverage fail-closed both ways HARVEST_ORPHAN+ENTITY_UNBACKED, per-field staleness with load-bearing + >20% stale-budget gates, overlay invariants, skeleton gates), idempotently INGESTS evidence-pointed agent CLAIMS via a staged-tree atomic swap, and RENDERS bounded progressive-disclosure views (BOOT_PACKET <=20000 bytes HARD with per-section budgets + a recorded degradation ladder + ?/~ uncertainty/stale markers, L0 system map, L1 capability cards, ALIASES) only from validated state. Ops: harvest, validate, ingest-claims, render, verify, query, reaffirm, fmt, selftest. Schema lifeorch.project_map/0.1: closed namespaces (module:/widget:/plane:/arch: number-only/contract:/doc:/store:/decision:/mandate:/pb:/iteration:/wave:/ops:/future:), per-field provenance, DERIVED load_bearing + member-of edges. Canonical bytes: LF, UTF-8, no BOM, sorted keys + explicitly sorted arrays; all sha256 over CRLF->LF-normalized bytes; KB=1000. Logical refusals are SKILL_CONTRACT v0.2 envelopes (exit 0, status:error, a machine error.code from the closed table); nonzero exit = crash only. READ-ONLY over the repo outside its own map/, generated/, runtime/, fixtures/. CPU-only, no model, no network -> determinism=deterministic, confidence=null, empty model_provenance. parallel_safe:false (ingest/render write shared map/ + generated/ state). Non-goals (NOT built here): the real overlay (orchestrator authors it at fold); any claims content (a parallel lane owns claims/); eval/ (orchestrator-owned); any #36 write path; any core-doc edit; any query beyond the closed set. v0.2.0 (i48, D-0133 CD-1+CD-3): (CD-1) a BOOT_PACKET OPERATIONS section renders the wave operational canon (clamps / gpu->git->doc lease order / fail-closed dev.ship + native-git HEAD verify + never git add -A / detached-server 0-orphan discipline / D-0077 fold-smoke) ONLY from validated ops:boot-* map state (never renderer prose), every line pointer-backed with >=1 repo path, within its own section budget and the LAST-to-degrade total-guard ladder position (min floor = one pointer line, never vanishes); authored via claims/i48-ops-canon-claims.json. (CD-3) query id resolution gains ns:NN and #NN/pos-NN short forms on entity/edges/redges/evidence/deeper (full ids stay BYTE-IDENTICAL to 0.1.0; unresolved short forms -> the existing DANGLING_REF; NO new query names or error codes); evidence: marks each source resolvable-at-harvest vs beyond-tree from harvest facts alone (inventory + decision_ids + core-doc list, no git), and every currency surface (freshness line, evidence currency) states BOTH the map-state (overlay) commit and the harvest/tree commit. v0.3.0 (i49, D-0136/D-0137) L2 narrative query surface: (N1) entity:<id> --fields <csv> --harvest serves a module/widget manifest field (esp. purpose) FROM THE HARVEST, provenance-stamped (harvest commit + skill.json ref/sha), bounded to FIELD_SERVE_MAX bytes (a purpose query envelope < 6000 B vs the raw-harvest grep); a NEW closed verb section:<id>#<heading> fetches ONE named SCHEMA_NOTES heading section (repo-READ-ONLY, --repo + --harvest, bounded to SECTION_FETCH_MAX, CRLF->LF sha-stamped, the natural resolution of a deeper[schema-notes] pointer); an unresolved module OR unknown heading refuses the EXISTING DANGLING_REF (no new error codes). (N2) the overlay frontier may carry rich candidates (item + gate/status + pointer) rendered into the BOOT_PACKET OVERLAY at handoff-s4 usefulness (schema/render/fixtures here; the real overlay stays orchestrator-authored at fold), self-fit to the section-4 budget with a documented total-guard position (degrades AFTER section3, BEFORE OPERATIONS; OPERATIONS still degrades LAST). (N3) the BOOT_PACKET RETRIEVAL PROTOCOL renders the FULL closed query set as an exact-invocation table from a SINGLE machine-readable QUERY_VERBS declaration that also gates the dispatcher (test-asserted equal), so an agent never needs project_map.py source to learn the verbs. Non-goals unchanged: no real overlay/map/generated writes, no #36/other-module writes (section is repo-READ-ONLY). v0.4.0 (i52, D-0142 N5+N6 -- the I51 NO-GO fix mechanisms): (N5, kills F1) the section: verb now ALSO serves (a) ONE named section of any mapped doc: entity's OWN file (core-docs + research docs; the id key IS the repo path) and (b) any file reachable via a mapped entity's typed deeper[] pointer through the NEW section:<id>:<kind>#<heading> form (closed serve kinds readme|research|schema-notes|work-order; the lexicographically-first path pointer of the kind serves; other kinds refuse UNSUPPORTED_QUERY); the selector matches an ATX heading EXACTLY as before (i49 module-SCHEMA_NOTES semantics preserved byte-identical, same-or-shallower span) and, when NO ATX heading matches, falls back to a line-leading **bold-label** block (label = bold text before the first '(' or ':'; span to the next ATX heading / bold-label line / EOF) so governing-doc TOP blocks like the AUDIT_PIPELINE Cadence header are query-servable; new serve classes mark target= doc-entity|deeper[kind] and selector=bold-label; all bounded to SECTION_FETCH_MAX, repo-READ-ONLY, CRLF->LF sha-stamped; unmapped targets/missing headings refuse the EXISTING DANGLING_REF. A NEW closed verb card:<id> (--harvest required) serves ONE rendered L1 card content-matching the committed L1_CARDS_* plane file (both render through the single _l1_card_lines source; bounded to CARD_FETCH_MAX; short forms resolve; stale marking included) so an agent never opens a whole plane file for one card. (N6, kills F3's packet half) claims/i52-n6-canon-claims.json extends the OPERATIONS boot canon with: the D-0064 rule AT FULL STRENGTH (ANY UI change needs a HUMAN live-GUI confirm BEFORE it is called done -- no softening), the K5 doc budgets + fail-closed ops/audit/doc-commit-gate.py commit gate, the mandate-02 SUNSET state (NO live mandate; SEALED_CHECK_47 armed opens i>=54; M2-A gate + PB triggers + cadence headers + monitor SURVIVE), and the NON-OPTIONAL design-first -> red-team-gated rule for audit increments; the OVERLAY section now renders EVERY overlay open_rulings[] entry with its ref (the K10 w08-rider drop closed; rulings, like prohibitions, are never ladder-degraded); the OPERATIONS section budget rose 2000->3000 so canon one_lines render verbatim at level 0 (OPERATIONS still degrades LAST; packet HARD 20000 B unchanged); every canon assertion is string-asserted against the golden packet incl. a negative that FAILS on softened D-0064 phrasing. No new error codes; no new files outside the closed query/claims surface. v0.4.1 (i60, D-0155 FO-6 repair): the Invoke-ProjectMap.ps1 entrypoint now passes -Repo through as --repo for every non-harvest action (query/render/validate/verify/reaffirm/fmt), provider-guarded (only when -Repo is set), mirroring the harvest branch, so query --q section:/card:/evidence: --harvest can resolve repo-backed content through the entrypoint (previously only the direct-python path worked); no new params/actions/query names/error codes.

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Action harvest|validate|ingest-claims|render|verify|query|reaffirm|fmt|selftest|report; -Repo <root>; -Map <map dir> (default <skill>/map); -Harvest <harvest.json>; -Out <dir>; -Claims <file>; -Q <query expr>; -Entity <id>; -Fields <csv>; -By <who>; -AtCommit <sha>; -PathsFile <file>; -Check; -Draft; -NoHarvest; -Override <reason>; -RepoState Skeleton|Folded (test smoke). The entrypoint captures git rev-parse HEAD + git status --porcelain and passes --at-commit/--dirty to the worker (dirty excludes modules/44-project-map/ itself). OR the generic -InputsJson '<json object>' (named params override matching keys). Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: harvest
inputs.description: path to a harvest.json produced by the harvest op (required by validate/render/verify on the real map).

inputs.name: out
inputs.description: render: output directory (generated/ non-draft, or a runtime/ dir with --draft).

inputs.name: claims
inputs.description: ingest-claims: path to a map_claims/0.1 file.

inputs.name: q
inputs.description: query: one of the closed query forms (see SCHEMA_NOTES RETRIEVAL PROTOCOL): entity/edges/redges/evidence/deeper/section (incl. doc-entity + :kind deeper forms)/card/alias/stale/changed-since.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: query entity:<id>: CSV of manifest fields (e.g. purpose) served BOUNDED from harvest; requires harvest (N1).

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: query section:...: repo root for the repo-READ-ONLY section fetch (N1/N5: SCHEMA_NOTES, doc: entity files, deeper[] targets).

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: render: re-render to a temp dir and byte-compare vs the committed out dir (drift gate).

inputs.name: draft
inputs.description: render: draft render (permitted ONLY with --out under runtime/); stamps DRAFT-STALE + status:error.

outputs.description: envelope.result is op-specific. harvest: {at_commit, dirty, counts{modules,widgets,core_docs,arch,decision_ids}, modules[], widgets[], core_docs[], doc_owner_rows[], decision_ids[], mandate{}, arch[], inventory{path:sha256}}. validate/verify: {ok, error_count, findings[{code,where,message}], stale[], coverage{orphans[],unbacked[]}, would_render_refuse}. ingest-claims: {merged, entities_upserted, edges_upserted, conflicts[]}. render: {out, files[{name,bytes,sha256}], boot_packet_bytes, ladder[], stale_count, degraded}. query: closed per-query result. fmt: {ok, nonconforming[]}. selftest: SELFTEST_*_OK lines in diagnostics. Refusals: status:error + error.code from the closed table (SCHEMA_INVALID ID_GRAMMAR UNKNOWN_NS UNKNOWN_EDGE_TYPE DUP_ID DUP_EDGE DANGLING_REF MISSING_PROVENANCE FIELD_UNCOVERED CLAIM_RESTATES_HARVEST CONFLICT_HARVEST CONFLICT_CLAIMS DERIVED_FIELD_AUTHORED HARVEST_ORPHAN ENTITY_UNBACKED STALE_LOAD_BEARING STALE_BUDGET OVERLAY_MANDATE_DRIFT OVERLAY_PROHIBITIONS_EMPTY OVERLAY_DANGLING SKELETON_UNRESOLVED SKELETON_LOAD_BEARING DIRTY_TREE DRAFT_RENDER PACKET_OVER_BUDGET GENERATED_DRIFT FMT_NONCANONICAL UNSUPPORTED_QUERY PARSE_ROW_FAILED).

side_effects: writes only modules/44-project-map/{map,generated,runtime} (READ-ONLY elsewhere; ingest stages under runtime/ and atomic-swaps map/)
